# Refine Experiences.   Drive Decisions.

## "I haven't met many people who are enthusiastic about filling in surveys."

And that was the aha moment for our founder & CEO, Shihab Muhammed. The third reminder to fill out his HR survey made him think, “Why do we not like surveys?” That was the beginning of everything. Shihab, & the initial team started putting together a feedback tool that can take away the 'boring' out of surveys. The Whatsapp's chat interface inspired him to keep the forms as conversational and intuitive as possible, guaranteeing 40% more response rates. And thus, SurveySparrow was born introducing the world's first chat surveys. Since then, SurveySparrow has now grown from a feedback tool to a complete omnichannel experience platform. The platform has extended and is continuously improving every aspect of it to deliver nothing but wows.

## What we hold close.    What drives us further.

Not the inspirational wall hangings, but the 6 pillars of our culture code, this is what we live & work by.

![Do the right thing](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/assets/about-us/do-the-right-thing-icon.svg)

### Do the right thing

We always aim to perform the best & not because anyone is watching. We thrive to do what’s right for the customer and the company.

![Passion](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/assets/about-us/passion-icon.svg)

### Passion

We inspire each other to find the passion & let that guide our actions. We’re driven by purpose.

![Solution-driven](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/assets/about-us/solution-driven-icon.svg)

### Solution-driven

We always find a way to get things done, a solution that can help, not a thousand more faults.

![Accountability](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/assets/about-us/accountability-icon.svg)

### Accountability

We hold ourselves accountable and never lose time in blame gaming. Whatever we do, we own it

![Make it work, make it better.](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/assets/about-us/make-it-work-make-it-better-icon.svg)

### Make it work, make it better.

We think big, act with urgency and do brilliant together. We’re the go-getters and the risk-takers.

![Deliver wows](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/assets/about-us/deliver-wows-icon.svg)

### Deliver wows

We don’t settle for anything but the best. We’re obsessed with refining everything we deliver.
